notes: Main source: the league's official 'Where to watch' broadcaster list (spl.com.sa/en/broadcasters and its content API; entries created/updated Jul-Oct 2026 for 2026-27). IMG distributes international rights through 2028-29; the league cites 45 partners in 180+ territories. Domestic/MENA: Thmanyah (SRMG) exclusive 2025-26 to 2030-31, free satellite channels plus subscription app per the deal announcement. Holders from 2025-26 that are NOT on the 2026-27 list: Network 10 / Paramount+ (Australia; free-to-air in 2025-26), DAZN France, Cosmote (Greece), Chinese platforms other than Best Sports, and the free official RSL YouTube live streams (UK, Nordics, Canada, NL, NZ, Serbia), which appear to have been replaced by the paid-or-unspecified Recast direct stream. Several smaller partners' free/pay status is unverified (noted per entry). The official list also puts StarTimes in Greece, which looks like a data error and was left out.
